source_row.rationale: Nicardipine, a dihydropyridine calcium channel blocker, causes arterial vasodilation, reducing systemic vascular resistance and blood pressure, commonly used as a titratable IV infusion for hypertensive emergencies.
source_row.source_detail: Mechanism of Action in Hypertensive Emergency
